fusions.name: Cloud Landing
fusions.desc: Drops into the middle of the swarm, dealing 8 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and healing you for 15% of the damage dealt. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Clean Plate
fusions.desc: A snap at a target at or below 25% health that deals 18 damage, consuming every affliction on it and adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the blow.

fusions.name: Cloud of Gnats
fusions.desc: Releases a swarm of gnats that fights for 12 seconds, biting an enemy within 5 tiles for 5 damage every 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Eats What Falls
fusions.desc: When you kill something, you heal for 20% of the damage you deal for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
